blocks.text: Glycoproteins ek protein aur ek carbohydrate polymer ke darmiyan covalent jor (linkage) se bante hain. Yeh qudrat mein aam hain: membranes ke zaroori structural hisse ke taur par, khoon ke serum mein, cells ki secretions (cells se nikalne wali rutubat) mein, aur cartilage, aankhon, jild waghaira mein.
